in_marathi.name: Harshal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harsh means mountain, and shal means half. This name is derived from the Hindu god Krishna, who is often depicted as holding a half moon on his chest. Harshal symbolizes the balance and harmony between masculine and feminine energies.
